messages:
maria: Heads-up — local eval harness dry-run hangs on quantized GPT-J variants when --prefix-cache is enabled. Repro steps below.

maria: Repro (on mac/linux WSL):
```
git checkout main
pip install -e ./eval_harness
runeval run --model gptj-quant --task summarization --dry-run --prefix-cache
```
It just sits at `Preparing prefixes...` for >5m.

devon: Huh. Is this the new 4-bit quant build? Any stacktrace?

maria: Using artifacts from samir's quant branch (4bit/q4_0). No python traceback; runner worker thread seems blocked. I attached a tiny strace snippet: `futex` waits inside prefix cache sync.

samir: Possible cause: prefix cache expects real KV cache semantics (float32 tensors) and when we mmap the quantized cache the size calc is off, causing the cache index goroutine to hang waiting for more bytes. Seen similar with vmap in our runtime.

lee: Quick triage: can you try `--no-prefix-cache` to unblock local dev? Also does `--dry-run` actually need prefix caching? For ergonomics, dry-run should be fully local-check without any cache population.

maria: `runeval run --model gptj-quant --dry-run --no-prefix-cache` works. Thanks. But CI uses dry-run in pre-merge checks, so this will fail PRs for teams hitting quantized models.

devon: CI angle: our GH action job uses the same command to validate configs. There's a cache step that restores `~/.eval_cache` keyed by model name + hash. If prefix-cache changes shape between quantized builds, cache restore could be corrupting things. We should add model-variant checksum to cache key.

ci-bot: Failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/gh/actions/4821 — step `validate-local` timed out after 15m.

evalbot: log excerpt:
```
[INFO] runner: starting dry-run
[DEBUG] cache: restoring ~/.eval_cache/gptj-quant -> 12MB
[INFO] runner: Preparing prefixes... (0/1)
# hangs here
```

samir: Proposed fixes: (1) Make dry-run bypass prefix-cache entirely (quick). (2) Add validation on cache restore: simple checksum + schema version. If mismatch, clear and warn. (3) Improve CLI: add `runeval validate-config [--fix]` command that returns non-zero on actionable warnings.

lee: I like (3) — user needs clearer failures vs soft warnings. Also we should standardize exit codes: 0 success, 1 user error (bad config), 2 infra error (cache/io/network), 3 flaky/transient. That helps CI distinguish flakiness.

devon: Agree. For GH action, we'll treat exit 1 as hard fail, exit 2 as retryable job. I'll update the action to retry on code 2 for up to 2 times, and add cache key fix (append `:${{ steps.compute_checksum.outputs.sha }}`).

maria: For the CLI UX: suggestion — add `--dry-run-mode=light|full` where `light` only validates config and dependencies, `full` runs the full pipeline but doesn't write outputs. That way local devs can do a fast check that won't touch caches.

samir: Implementation notes: runtime needs a `dry_run_mode` flag; in `light` skip kernel instantiation and prefix cache setup. Also add a small unit test that simulates a corrupted cache file (write header with wrong schema version) and assert runner clears it and emits a `CACHE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH` warning.

lee: Also update docs: CLI reference + quickstart should show `runeval validate-config` and explain exit codes. Devex will add a short snippet to the onboarding doc.

maria: I'll open a PR with: fix to skip prefix-cache in light dry-run, new `validate-config` subcommand, and one GH Action tweak. Assigning reviewers: @samir for runtime bits, @devon for CI, @lee for docs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

devon: I'll add the cache-checksum step and GH action retry logic in a separate PR if you want me to.

samir: I'll prototype the cache schema header (magic + version + checksum) and a small parser that auto-migrates or clears.

lee: Nice. Small follow-ups: add a one-liner in evalbot failure notifications suggesting `--dry-run-mode=light` when model is quantized. Could we make that auto-detect?

maria: Good idea. If model name contains `-quant` or `q4` we can hint. I'll include that in the PR.

devon: One more CI nit: GH runner macOS images have different mmap alignment; unit tests that rely on exact offsets should use tempfile and portable assumptions. Switched two tests earlier for that.

maria: Cool. Thanks all — I'll create the issue and PR now and post links here.

maria: Issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2237 (configs + dry-run hangs)

maria: PR: https://redwood.internal/pulls/5012 (draft) — tagging reviewers.

samir: Reviewed the PR description. small suggestion: mention expected exit codes in the commit message.

lee: I'll draft the docs patch after PR merges.

devon: LGTM.

maria: Closing thread for now — followups will be on the PR. :white_check_mark:
